def solve(grid, mindim=None, minarea=None):
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    # find maximal solid rectangles (not extendable in any direction)
    marks=set()
    # enumerate maximal rects: for each cell, extend right/down greedily then check all 4 directions
    for i in range(h):
        for j in range(w):
            v=grid[i][j]
            # max width starting here going right, and max height for each width -> use classic: for each (i,j) find largest rectangle with top-left here that is maximal (cannot extend up/left either since we require top-left corner start)
            WW=0
            while j+WW<w and grid[i][j+WW]==v: WW+=1
            best=[]
            for ww in range(1,WW+1):
                hh=0
                while i+hh<h and all(grid[i+hh][j+y]==v for y in range(ww)): hh+=1
                # maximal: cannot extend left, up, right(ww==WW ensures), down
                extL = j>0 and all(grid[i+x][j-1]==v for x in range(hh))
                extU = i>0 and all(grid[i-1][j+y]==v for y in range(ww))
                if not extL and not extU and hh*ww>=1:

new='''

def maximal_rectangles(grid):
    """All maximal solid same-color rectangles as (color, top, left, height, width, area); maximal means non-extendable up, down, left, and right."""
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    out, seen = [], set()
    for i in range(h):
        for j in range(w):
            v = grid[i][j]
            WW = 0
            while j+WW < w and grid[i][j+WW] == v: WW += 1
            for k in range(1, WW+1):
                hh = 0
                while i+hh < h and all(grid[i+hh][j+y] == v for y in range(k)): hh += 1
                if hh == 0: continue
                if i > 0 and all(grid[i-1][j+y] == v for y in range(k)): continue
                if i+hh < h and all(grid[i+hh][j+y] == v for y in range(k)): continue
                if j+k < w and all(grid[i+x][j+k] == v for x in range(hh)): continue
                if j > 0 and all(grid[i+x][j-1] == v for x in range(hh)): continue
                key = (v, i, j, hh, k)
                if key not in seen:
                    seen.add(key)
                    out.append((v, i, j, hh, k, hh*k))
    return out
